units.en: 어디예요? (Where is it?) + any place name is your most-used travel phrase. Add 가주세요 (please take me there) in a taxi for instant navigation.
units.value: 어디예요？（在哪裡？）加上任何地點名稱是最常用的旅遊句型。搭計程車時加上가주세요（請帶我去那裡）就能立即導航。

units.en: Male speakers use 형 (older brother) and 누나 (older sister). Female speakers use 오빠 (older brother) and 언니 (older sister). This is one of Korean's most distinctive features.
units.value: 男性說話者用 형（哥哥）和 누나（姊姊）。女性說話者用 오빠（哥哥）和 언니（姊姊）。這是韓語最具特色的語言現象之一。

units.en: Knowing body-part vocabulary is essential for doctor visits, describing symptoms, and everyday conversation. Korean body-part names are mostly native Korean words, though medical terminology often uses Sino-Korean.
units.value: 學會身體部位詞彙對看醫生、描述症狀和日常對話都至關重要。韓語身體部位名稱大多是固有語，但醫學術語通常使用漢字語。

Which stroke comes FIRST in ㅏ?
units.value: ㅏ 中最先寫的是哪一筆？

units.en: Top ㄱ first. Then the middle bar left to right. Then the bottom ㄴ.
units.value: 先寫上方的ㄱ。再由左向右寫中間橫線。最後寫下方的ㄴ。

units.en: Bar first, left to right. Then the left stem down, then the right stem down.
units.value: 先由左向右寫橫線。再寫左邊短豎向下，然後右邊短豎向下。

units.en: Draw the vertical from top to bottom. Then the tick, from the line outward to the right.
units.value: 由上而下寫豎線。再從豎線向右外側寫短畫。

units.en: Every hangul letter is built from a handful of simple strokes, and those strokes always come in the same order. Three rules cover all of them.
units.value: 每個韓文字母都由幾個簡單的筆畫組成，而這些筆畫的書寫順序始終固定。三條規則就能涵蓋全部。

units.en: Word mode is different from the syllable drill: nothing advances until you press Space. That is your submit key. If you mistype, Backspace peels off one letter at a time so you can fix it before you send.
units.value: 單字模式和音節練習不同：在你按空白鍵之前，什麼都不會前進。空白鍵就是你的送出鍵。如果打錯了，Backspace 會一次剝掉一個字母，讓你在送出前修正。
